title: fix(polli-cli): add image modality flags to my-models
author: iotserver24
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #12853

- Add `--modality text|image` on `create` and `test` so image endpoints can be registered and probed
- Add `--image-pricing request|tokens` on `create`/`update`
- Add `--completion-image-price` so an image model can be priced from the CLI
- Show `modality`, `image_price`, and `inputs` (`inputModalities`) in the table; `--json` carries every new field
- Export `modelBody` and cover create/update image fields with unit tests

`--supports-image-edits` is not added: that column is now `legacySupportsImageEdits` and the live API uses `--input-modalities` (already present). `update` has no `--modality` because `UpdateEndpointSchema` has no such field.

gist.headline: Image models get a CLI key
gist.blurb: Polli CLI can now register, price, and probe image endpoints without making anyone hand-edit a request body in the bushes. The model table also learned to show what each endpoint can actually eat.
gist.summary: Added image-model support to `polli-cli my-models`: `create` and `test` now accept `--modality text|image`, create/update accept `--image-pricing request|tokens` and `--completion-image-price`, and listings expose modality, image price, and input modalities.
gist.impact: Developers can now configure and validate priced image endpoints directly from the CLI, with both table and JSON output showing the new image-specific model metadata.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model-registration desk in a garden hackerspace: Polli wears a tiny mechanic tool belt and uses a retro terminal to attach an image-frame icon and price tag to a blooming code-plant labeled as an image endpoint. The terminal table visibly includes small columns for modality, image price, and inputs, with pixel flowers and vines making the configuration work feel like tending a useful little greenhouse.
